Look at the image below. In 25 seconds, please speak into the microphone and describe in detail what the image is showing. You will have 40 seconds to give your response.
ITEM IMAGE
EXAMPLE ANSWER
This
black-and-white
illustration
shows
five
steps
for
preparing
coffee
,
displayed
in
two
rows
of
three
and
two
panels
using
a
simple
sketch
style
with
bold
outlines
.
The
process
begins
with
spooning
coffee
grounds
into
a
cup
,
then
adding
sugar
from
a
sachet
.
The
mixture
is
stirred
to
dissolve
the
ingredients
before
hot
water
is
poured
from
a
kettle
,
with
steam
lines
suggesting
it
is
freshly
boiled
.
The
final
step
shows
a
completed
cup
of
steaming
coffee
,
with
beans
scattered
beside
the
saucer
that
visually
echo
the
grounds
added
in
the
first
step
.
The
word
"
Coffee
"
in
handwritten
text
at
the
bottom
,
along
with
arrows
and
motion
lines
throughout
,
creates
a
clear
visual
guide
for
each
stage
.
